title: Add Telegram and Apprise vars to the env schema
acceptance: WHEN the env-schema test loads `backend/src/infrastructure/config/env.ts` with `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=123456:TEST` and neither `APPRISE_URL` nor `TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME` set THE SYSTEM SHALL expose `config.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` as `123456:TEST`, `config.APPRISE_URL` as `http://apprise:8000` and `config.TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME` as the empty string.
WHEN the env-schema test loads the module with `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` set to the empty string THE SYSTEM SHALL call `process.exit(1)`.
WHEN the env-schema test loads the module with `APPRISE_URL=not-a-url` THE SYSTEM SHALL call `process.exit(1)`.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

WHEN `backend/.env.example` and the root `.env.example` are read THE SYSTEM SHALL find a line starting `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=` and a line starting `TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME=` in each, plus a line starting `APPRISE_URL=` in `backend/.env.example`.
WHEN `backend/src/__tests__/apiRoutes.test.ts` is read THE SYSTEM SHALL find `process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN = 'test';` among its env assignments.

title: Wire Telegram variables into docker-compose
acceptance: WHEN `docker-compose.yml` is searched for the line `- TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}` THE SYSTEM SHALL find exactly 2 occurrences, the `backend` and `worker` services being the only two that carry `APPRISE_URL`.
WHEN `docker-compose.yml` is searched for the line `- TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME=${TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME:-}` THE SYSTEM SHALL find exactly 2 occurrences.
WHEN `docker-compose.yml` is searched for `- APPRISE_URL=http://apprise:8000` THE SYSTEM SHALL still find exactly 2 occurrences.
WHEN `git diff -U0 HEAD -- docker-compose.yml` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL show zero removed lines.
verify: git rev-parse --verify -q HEAD >/dev/null && test -z "$(git diff -U0 HEAD -- docker-compose.yml | grep -E '^-([^-]|$)')"

title: Add Telegram link columns to User
acceptance: WHEN `(cd backend && npx prisma generate)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 and `backend/node_modules/.prisma/client/index.d.ts` SHALL contain `telegramChatId:`, `telegramLinkCode:` and `telegramLinkCodeExpiresAt:`.

WHEN the migration file `backend/prisma/migrations/20261120000000_add_telegram_notification_fields/migration.sql` is read THE SYSTEM SHALL contain `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` statements for `telegram_chat_id` (`TEXT`), `telegram_link_code` (`TEXT`) and `telegram_link_code_expires_at` (`TIMESTAMP(3)`) on `"users"`, and `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "users_telegram_link_code_key"`.
WHEN that migration file is searched case-insensitively for `DROP`, `NOT NULL` or `ALTER COLUMN` THE SYSTEM SHALL find no match.
WHEN `git diff -U0 HEAD -- backend/prisma/schema.prisma` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL show zero removed lines, so `telegramUsername`, `notifyEmail`, `notifyTelegram` and `notifySms` are unchanged.

WHEN `(cd backend && npx vitest run src/modules/identity/__tests__/UpdateProfile.test.ts src/modules/identity/__tests__/CurrentUserResolver.test.ts)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, proving the frozen profile-update and user-resolution behaviour is unchanged.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.
verify: grep -qF 'ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "telegram_chat_id" TEXT;' backend/prisma/migrations/20261120000000_add_telegram_notification_fields/migration.sql
grep -qF 'ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "telegram_link_code" TEXT;' backend/prisma/migrations/20261120000000_add_telegram_notification_fields/migration.sql
grep -qF 'ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "telegram_link_code_expires_at" TIMESTAMP(3);' backend/prisma/migrations/20261120000000_add_telegram_notification_fields/migration.sql
grep -qF 'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "users_telegram_link_code_key" ON "users"("telegram_link_code");' backend/prisma/migrations/20261120000000_add_telegram_notification_fields/migration.sql
status=0; grep -qiE 'DROP|NOT NULL|ALTER COLUMN' backend/prisma/migrations/20261120000000_add_telegram_notification_fields/migration.sql || status=$?; test "$status" -eq 1
git rev-parse --verify -q HEAD >/dev/null && test -z "$(git diff -U0 HEAD -- backend/prisma/schema.prisma | grep -E '^-([^-]|$)')"

title: Define Notifier port, errors and NotifierRegistry
acceptance: WHEN a notifier is registered as `apprise` and `NotifierRegistry.resolve()` is called with no name THE SYSTEM SHALL return that same instance.
WHEN `NotifierRegistry.resolve('email')` is called and nothing is registered under `email` THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `Notifier 'email' is not registered.`

WHEN `new NotificationChannelNotLinkedError('TELEGRAM_DISABLED')` is constructed THE SYSTEM SHALL produce an `Error` instance whose `reason` is `TELEGRAM_DISABLED` and whose `name` is `NotificationChannelNotLinkedError`.
WHEN `new NotificationDeliveryError('x', 424)` is constructed THE SYSTEM SHALL produce an `Error` instance whose `status` is 424.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

title: Implement AppriseNotifier
acceptance: WHEN `send('123456789', 'hola', 'Contrata360')` runs against a stubbed `fetch` with base URL `http://apprise.test:8000/` and bot token `TEST_TOKEN` THE SYSTEM SHALL POST exactly once to `http://apprise.test:8000/notify/` with header `Content-Type: application/json` and a JSON body equal to `{ "urls": "tgram://TEST_TOKEN/123456789", "body": "hola", "title": "Contrata360" }`.
WHEN the stubbed Apprise responds with status 424 THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with a `NotificationDeliveryError` whose `status` is 424.
WHEN the stubbed `fetch` rejects with a network error THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with a `NotificationDeliveryError` whose message does not contain `TEST_TOKEN`.
WHEN `send` is called with recipient `12/34` THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with a `NotificationDeliveryError` and SHALL NOT call `fetch`.
WHEN `backend/src/modules/notifications/infrastructure/AppriseNotifier.ts` is searched for `console.` or `logger.` THE SYSTEM SHALL find no match.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

title: Implement NotificationService.sendToUser
acceptance: WHEN `sendToUser('user-1', 'hola', 'Contrata360')` runs for a user with `notifyTelegram: true` and `telegramChatId: '123456789'` THE SYSTEM SHALL call the resolved notifier's `send` exactly once with `'123456789'`, `'hola'` and `'Contrata360'`.
WHEN the user has `telegramChatId: null` THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with `NotificationChannelNotLinkedError` whose `reason` is `TELEGRAM_NOT_LINKED` and SHALL NOT call `send`.

WHEN the user has `telegramChatId: '123456789'` and `notifyTelegram: false` THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with `NotificationChannelNotLinkedError` whose `reason` is `TELEGRAM_DISABLED` and SHALL NOT call `send`.
WHEN no user row exists for the id THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with `NotificationChannelNotLinkedError` whose `reason` is `TELEGRAM_NOT_LINKED`.
WHEN the notifier's `send` rejects with a `NotificationDeliveryError` THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with that same error instance.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

title: Add Telegram link-code issuance
acceptance: WHEN `generateTelegramLinkCode()` is called 1000 times THE SYSTEM SHALL return only strings matching `^[A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{8}$`.

WHEN `createTelegramLinkCode('user-1', new Date('2026-11-20T10:00:00.000Z'))` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL call `prisma.user.update` with `where: { id: 'user-1' }`, `telegramLinkCode` equal to the returned code, and `telegramLinkCodeExpiresAt` equal to `2026-11-20T10:15:00.000Z`.
WHEN the first `prisma.user.update` rejects with an error whose `code` is `P2002` THE SYSTEM SHALL retry with a new code and resolve on the second attempt.
WHEN `prisma.user.update` rejects with `P2002` on all 3 attempts THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with the message `Could not allocate a unique Telegram link code`.
WHEN `prisma.user.update` rejects with an error whose `code` is `P2025` THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with that error after exactly 1 call.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx vitest run src/modules/notifications/__tests__/NotificationService.test.ts)` and `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` run THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 for both.

title: Match /start codes in TelegramLinkGateway
acceptance: WHEN `handleUpdate` receives `{ update_id: 1, message: { text: '/start ABCD2345', chat: { id: 123456789 } } }` and that code belongs to user `user-1` with an expiry after now THE SYSTEM SHALL call `prisma.user.update` with `where: { id: 'user-1' }` and data `{ telegramChatId: '123456789', telegramLinkCode: null, telegramLinkCodeExpiresAt: null }` and resolve `linked`.
WHEN the matching user's `telegramLinkCodeExpiresAt` is earlier than or equal to now THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve `ignored` and SHALL NOT call `prisma.user.update`.
WHEN no user holds the code THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve `ignored` and SHALL NOT call `prisma.user.update`.
WHEN the message text is `hola` or the update has no `message` THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve `ignored` without calling `prisma.user.findUnique`.
WHEN `TelegramLinkGateway.parseStartCode('/start@ContrataBot abcd2345')` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL return `ABCD2345`, and WHEN it runs on `/start ABC` THE SYSTEM SHALL return `null`.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

title: Add the getUpdates long-poll loop
acceptance: WHEN `pollOnce()` runs for the first time THE SYSTEM SHALL request path `/botTEST_TOKEN/getUpdates` on `api.telegram.org` with query parameters `offset=0`, `timeout=25` and `allowed_updates=["message"]`.

WHEN that response is `{ "ok": true, "result": [...] }` holding updates with `update_id` 41 and 42 THE SYSTEM SHALL pass both to `handleUpdate` in order, and the next `pollOnce()` SHALL request `offset=43`.
WHEN `getUpdates` responds with HTTP 409 THE SYSTEM SHALL reject `pollOnce()` with an error whose message contains `409` and does not contain `TEST_TOKEN`, and SHALL NOT call `handleUpdate`.
WHEN `handleUpdate` throws for update 41 in a batch of 41 and 42 THE SYSTEM SHALL still call `handleUpdate` for 42 and the next request SHALL use `offset=43`.
WHEN `start()` is called and `stop()` is then called while a long-poll request is in flight THE SYSTEM SHALL abort that request's `AbortSignal` and `stop()` SHALL resolve.
WHEN the first poll after `start()` fails and `errorBackoffMs` is 1 THE SYSTEM SHALL issue a second `getUpdates` request after the backoff.

title: Add notifications controller and schemas
acceptance: WHEN `createTelegramLinkCode` runs with no `req.user` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401 with `{ error: 'Unauthorized' }` and SHALL NOT call the service.

WHEN `createTelegramLinkCode` runs for user `user-1`, the service returns code `ABCD2345` expiring at `2026-11-20T10:15:00.000Z`, and the bot username is `ContrataTestBot` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 with `{ code: 'ABCD2345', expiresAt: '2026-11-20T10:15:00.000Z', botDeepLink: 'https://t.me/ContrataTestBot?start=ABCD2345' }`.
WHEN the bot username is the empty string THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 with `botDeepLink` equal to `null`.

WHEN `sendTest` runs and the service rejects with `NotificationChannelNotLinkedError('TELEGRAM_NOT_LINKED')` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 409 with a JSON body whose `code` is `TELEGRAM_NOT_LINKED` and whose `error` is a non-empty string.
WHEN `sendTest` runs and the service rejects with a `NotificationDeliveryError` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 502 with `code` equal to `DELIVERY_FAILED`.
WHEN `sendTest` runs and the service resolves THE SYSTEM SHALL call `sendToUser` with `user-1`, `TEST_NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE` and `TEST_NOTIFICATION_TITLE` and respond 200 with `{ delivered: true }`.

title: Mount the notifications router
acceptance: WHEN `POST /api/v1/notifications/telegram/link-code` is sent with no `Authorization` header to an Express app mounting `notificationsRouter` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401.
WHEN `POST /api/v1/notifications/test` is sent with no `Authorization` header THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401.

WHEN `POST /api/v1/notifications/telegram/link-code` is sent with `Authorization: Bearer test-token` for a resolvable user THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 with a `code` matching `^[A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{8}$` and a `botDeepLink` equal to `https://t.me/ContrataTestBot?start=` followed by that code.
WHEN `POST /api/v1/notifications/test` is sent with `Authorization: Bearer test-token` and body `{ "extra": 1 }` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 400.

WHEN `backend/src/server.ts` is searched THE SYSTEM SHALL find the notifications mount line built from `API_PREFIX` and `notificationsRouter`, the `notificationsRouter` import on a later line than the `authRouter` import, and the existing `auth`, `procurement` and `analytics` mount lines unchanged.

WHEN `(cd backend && npm run build)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, emit `backend/dist/modules/notifications/presentation/routes.js`, and the built `AppriseNotifier.js` SHALL load with `require` and exit 0.

title: Run the link gateway in the worker
acceptance: WHEN `backend/src/worker.ts` is imported by the worker-shutdown test THE SYSTEM SHALL construct one `TelegramLinkGateway` and call its `start()` exactly once.
WHEN `gracefulShutdown('SIGTERM')` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL call `telegramLinkGateway.stop()` together with the 5 BullMQ worker `close()` calls and exit with code 0.

WHEN the existing shutdown test's single `await gracefulShutdown('SIGTERM')` call completes THE SYSTEM SHALL show, asserted inside that same test with no separate `it()` block, a `telegramLinkGateway.stop` `invocationCallOrder[0]` lower than the `prisma.$disconnect` `invocationCallOrder[0]`.

WHEN the worker-shutdown test runs THE SYSTEM SHALL still pass all 12 pre-existing call assertions in the existing shutdown test: 5 worker `close()`, 5 queue `close()`, `redisWorkerClient.quit()` and `prisma.$disconnect()`.

WHEN `(cd backend && npm run build)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, `backend/dist/worker.js` SHALL reference `TelegramLinkGateway`, and the built `TelegramLinkGateway.js` SHALL load with `require` and exit 0.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx vitest run src/modules/notifications)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with 0 failed tests.
